text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! I worked up a sweat there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pearl and I are at summer camp, and we're
making good progress
through the training
regimen I prepared.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now we can enjoy our free time! Let us go
see the festival!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No, no! I'm talking about a more
international festival! Here, take a
look at
this invitation. Follow meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We go to the location written on her
invitation. I don't remember any
summer
festivals being held around here...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Welcome, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Why did Pearl just make that dramatic
entrance?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl presents... the
International Carnival of Love and
Hope!
Enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Feel the passion from the country of
sunshine! Dance to the beat of
the music!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, I find myself swept up in
the flow and following
Pearl's dance steps!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What's up, Trainer! Say hoo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My, looks like you're awfully fired up,
Trainer! I'll need to cool you
down. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This Asian summer festival will blast the
summer heat away! Let's
shooooot!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, bring your eyes to the next
attraction—rocket magic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pew, pew, peeew!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Firework rockets light up the night sky.
Faced with all of these
attractions, I can't
help but feel a little overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks displays are loved across the
world! May our year be
blessed with peace
and great fortune! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The main dish is still to come! Let us move
to the uninhabited island!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, the stars are starting to come out.
How beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But what I really want to show you... is a
gemstone burning brightly in
the night
sky...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So bright you can't help but reach out and
try to grasp it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pearl gives some sort of signal. Soon after,
a shrill sound pierces the
quiet night...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the starry sky glitters with fiery
gemstones.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the finale. These are my
feelings...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fireworks grow in intensity, spelling
out large letters in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "!UOY KNAHT"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Something the matter? ...Wait, no! The
letters are backwards!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that message, I think I know why
Pearl held this festival
tonight. Still...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, yes you have. You just haven't
realized it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I make mistakes like this every now and
then, don't I? But every
time... you take it
in stride.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It was the same when you helped me with
the bento shop. I was only
thinking of
letting more people experience those
amazing bentos.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So when you prepared a food truck and
helped the owner get his
confidence back,
I was surprised.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...I always run out alone. Even so, someone
always makes sure to have
my back. You're
that someone, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today's festival is my way of showing my
appreciation for you. ...Even
if I messed up
at the end.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear it, but I really wanted
tonight to be perfect. Haha, I'll
have to
prepare better next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pearl seems to be a bit remorseful about
her tendency to rush into
things. But
honestly... she has no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want Pearl to reach the top of the racing
world on her own
terms—filled with
passion, true to her beliefs. And to that
end...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I can't win when it comes to you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! "Charge ahead," you say?! I've
never heard of a more
magnificent plan!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Your wish is my command! Let us charge
forward into the future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We will run in every race across the
globe... Conquering the racing
world isn't
just a dream!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't that what you wanted from me? If
I play my cards right, I can
even surpass
the world itself!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For example, I could race on the moon
against space Umamusume!
Haha, the
possibilities are limitless!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I have an infinite amount of possibilities at
my fingertips—and it's
because I know
you'll be right beside me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, dependable words.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The two of us will keep on charging ahead.
We'll shine brighter than
the world, or
anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No one knows what lies in our future, but
what I do know is that
whatever may
come... I'll be standing right by her side.
